title: Individual Components of Polymyxin B Modeled via Population Pharmacokinetics to Design Humanized Dosage Regimens for a Bloodstream and Lung Infection Model in Immune-Competent Mice
locator: Methods / Population pharmacokinetic modeling and ELF concentration calculation
quote: to model free and total drug
summary: Component-specific murine models distinguish plasma and ELF, include saturable ELF binding and consider SC absorption. BAL-to-ELF dilution uses paired urea measurements. Humanized mouse exposures target known human PK.
validation: Reverse translation and animal validation do not establish blinded animal-to-human prediction. Total ELF accumulation cannot be equated with free exposure.
data_availability: Supplementary material listed; executable model and complete raw dataset not verified.
